outcome: Neurological disorders before and after pregnancy
cohort: 250 women with a high risk of neurological disorders
finding: Neurological conditions were frequently reported during pregnancy, particularly seizures, migraine, cerebral venous and intracranial hypertension, and sinus thrombosis.
mod_finding: The majority of participants (62%) underwent C-section.
gest_age: Full-term, preterm, and abortion (specific proportions reported)
